title: Karhunen Loève Expansions of Hilbert Space-Valued Random Elements
summary: The Karhunen-Loève Expansion (KLE) of a stochastic process is a well understood eigenfunction expansion used widely in time series analysis, stochastic PDEs, and signal processing. Karhunen-Loève expansions have also been proven to exist for other types of stochastic elements whose values lie in certain $L^2$ spaces. This article provides a concise proof about the necessary and sufficient conditions for a function $v$ defined on some sample space $Ω$ and whose values lie in some Hilbert space $\mathcal H$ to admit an eigenfunction expansion like the well-known KLE.
